_comment: Rows for /pokemon-black-friday-2026 (Deal Hunter, Goal League S1; BET-20261107-1). sold = median of the most recent completed eBay sales PriceCharting lists for that exact sealed product (eBay rows only), last 30 days; from/asOf = first and last sale counted; n = sales counted. Same title rules as data/sealed-prices.json: the sale names its own set and no other set; multi-unit lots, combos, sleeved packs and blisters, damaged wrap and opened product are dropped. launch = US launch price (Pokémon KB 02 §1.4/§4, ADDENDA; never called MSRP); a booster box has no published retail price, so its line is the 36 × pack arithmetic. bf = a Black Friday advertised price: null until a dated retailer ad or listing shows one, then {price, retailer, seen} (an ask, labelled, never linked). gap = sold median − advertised, arithmetic only. checked = the last date we looked for Black Friday prices. eBay is a search link only, never a mark. Edit here, then run: node tools/build-black-friday.mjs. Never hand-edit the BF or BFLD blocks. Nov 10 PT (CEO Desk amendment, Nov 9): tables run boxes first, then Pokémon Center ETBs (their own table; a sale counts only if the title says Pokémon Center/PC/PKC and names the set), then ETBs, bundles, the 30th UPCs; older sets we index joined each table. launch: null on a row = no launch line (sets older than the KB's launch-price range). Surging Sparks Pokémon Center ETB left out: the KB pack count (11) covers 2025–26 editions only. Nov 22 PT (BET-20261121-1, CoS-approved): calendar = the Black Friday week block under the answer (Mon Nov 23 → Fri Dec 4): kind remark = this page's own sold-price re-read; event = calendar date; release = a dated launch with its source on the linked page. A store sale window goes in only with the store's own dated page. answerName = the name used in the answer sentence (retail ETB says so, O-71). Re-read 2026-11-23 UTC (Nov 22 evening PT), same title rules; added: series prefixes (Sword & Shield, Scarlet & Violet, Mega Evolution) and an acrylic protector don't make a title a combo or another set; '30th Anniversary' titles count as 30th Celebration (same product, collectors' name for it); a templated 'Original Packaging' listing that sold at converted prices well above the rest is dropped; 'display' titles dropped. Re-read 2026-11-24 PT (Tue evening; sales dated through Nov 24 UTC, later ones left for the next read), same title rules; added: 'x 2' / '(2)' / 'and 1 regular ETB' multiples, 'w/ case' or protector, weighed 'heavy' listings and dinged/damaged wrap dropped. Calendar re-reads moved to the days this page is actually re-read (Thu Nov 26, Sun Nov 29, Tue Dec 1); the Sat Nov 28 row is gone.
